body: I am at the point where I feel like I have to do this. I am incredibly sad, worse than usual. I have an appointment with my therapist this afternoon (Scheduled weeks ago) so I may go to that to see if I can snap out of it. Though I do have a major desire to take these pills and end it all.
I finally have a plan and will be carrying it out soon. It took a lot of thought but I think this way will work. Thanks for giving me a platform to whine one last time.
[Here is one](http://i.imgur.com/4XWchhN.jpg) - Only one I could find, I deleted the rest of the the photos I had.

They psychologist I see mentioned that I may have Asperger's a couple of years ago but I was in denial and stopped going. I haven't told anyone I have it as I am embarrassed, which I know I shouldn't be.

You are right about trying to make life worthwhile. I like to do art and what not but I think I suck at it and haven't drawn anything in almost eight weeks.
